sanskrit: mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu vayaṃ tvendhānās tanvaṃ puṣema | mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaś catasras tvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema ||
english: O Agni, may splendor be mine at the invocations; kindled by thee, may we nourish our bodies. May the four quarters bow down to me; with thee as overseer may we conquer armies.

sanskrit: agne manyuṃ pratinudan pareṣāṃ tvaṃ no gopāḥ pari pāhi viśvataḥ | apāñco yantu prabudhā durasyavo 'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ bahudhā vi naśyatu ||
english: O Agni, thrusting back the fury of our foes, thou art our herdsman — guard us on every side. Let the ill-willed foes turn away, wide awake though they be; may the mind of these wicked ones be scattered in many ways.

sanskrit: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇur agniḥ | mamāntarikṣam urulokam astu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin ||
english: May all the gods be at my invocation — the Maruts with Indra, Viṣṇu, Agni. May the wide intermediate space be mine; in this my desire, may Vāyu blow favorably for me.

sanskrit: mahyaṃ yajantāṃ mama yānīṣṭā- -ākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu | eno mā ni gāṃ katamac canāhaṃ viśve devā abhi rakṣantu mām iha ||
english: May they sacrifice to me; may what is dear to me be true in purpose, the intention of my mind. Into no sin whatsoever shall I fall; may all the gods protect me here.

sanskrit: mahyaṃ devā draviṇam ā yajantāṃ mamāśīr astu mama devahūtiḥ | daivā hotāraḥ saniṣan na etad ariṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ ||
english: May the gods sacrifice wealth unto me; mine shall be the blessing, mine the invocation of the gods. May the divine priests win this for us; may we be unharmed in body, well-heroied.

sanskrit: devīḥ ṣaḍ urvīr uru ṇas karātha viśve devāsa iha mādayadhvam | mā hāsmahi prajayā mā dhanena mā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan ||
english: O divine, wide six realms, make broad space for us; all ye gods, rejoice here. May we not be bereft of offspring, not of wealth; may we not be delivered to the hater, O King Soma.

sanskrit: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yacchād asmin vāje puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ | sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍa- -indra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ ||
english: May the wide-ranging great one extend shelter to us in this contest, the much-invoked one of abundant food. O bay-horsed Indra, be gracious to us for our offspring; harm us not, deliver us not over.

sanskrit: dhātā vidhartā bhuvanasya yas patiḥ savitā devo abhimātiṣāhaḥ | bṛhaspatir indrāgnī aśvinobhā devāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nirṛthāt ||
english: Dhātṛ, Vidhātṛ, the lord of the world; divine Savitṛ, conqueror of enemies; Bṛhaspati, Indra, Agni, and both Aśvins — may these gods protect the sacrificer from Nirṛti.

sanskrit: ihārvāñcam ati hvaya indraṃ jaitrāya jetave | asmākam astu kevala itaḥ kṛṇotu vīryam ||
english: Call Indra hitherward, here beyond, for the victory of the conqueror. Let him be ours alone; from here let him work heroic power.

sanskrit: arvāñcam indram amuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajid aśvajid yaḥ | imaṃ no yajñaṃ vihave juṣasva- -asmākaṃ kṛṇmo harivo medinaṃ tvā ||
english: We call Indra hitherward from yonder — him who wins cattle, wins wealth, wins horses. Be pleased with this our sacrifice at the invocation; O bay-horsed one, we make thee our ally.

sanskrit: trātāram indram avitāram indraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūram indram | huvema śakraṃ puruhūtam indraṃ svasti no maghavān pātv indraḥ ||
english: Indra the protector, Indra the helper, easily invoked in every call, Indra the hero — let us invoke the mighty one, the much-invoked Indra; may Indra the bountiful guard our well-being.

sanskrit: tisro devīr mahi me śarma yacchan prajāyai me tanve yac ca puṣṭam | māṃ viśaḥ saṃmanaso juṣantāṃ pitryaṃ kṣetraṃ prati jānātv asmān ||
english: The three goddesses bestow great shelter upon me, and also prosperity upon my offspring and body. May the clans of one mind be well-disposed toward me; may the ancestral field acknowledge us.

sanskrit: yo naḥ śakrābhimanyunā- -indrāmitro jighāṃsati | tvaṃ taṃ vṛtrahañ jahi vasv asmabhyam ā bhara ||
english: He who with Śakra's fury as Indra's enemy seeks to slay us — smite thou him, O Vṛtra-slayer; bring wealth hither to us.

sanskrit: ye naḥ śapanty apa te bhavantv indrāgnibhyām apa bādhāmahe tān | ādityā rudrā uparispṛśo mām ugraṃ cettāram adhirājam akran ||
english: Those who curse us — let them come to naught; by Indra and Agni we repel them. May the Ādityas and Rudras who touch the heights make me the fierce overseer, the supreme sovereign.

sanskrit: pṛthivī vaśā sāgniṃ garbhaṃ dadhe semaṃ pāhi tasyai te vidheyaṃ tasyai te namas tasmai te svāhā ||
english: Earth is the sacrificial cow; she bears Agni as her embryo. Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.

sanskrit: antarikṣaṃ vaśā sā vāyuṃ garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: The atmosphere is the sacrificial cow; she bears Vāyu as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: dyaur vaśā sā sūryaṃ garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: Heaven is the sacrificial cow; she bears Sūrya as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: ṛg vaśā sā sāma garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: The Ṛg-veda is the sacrificial cow; she bears the Sāman as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇā vaśā sā yajñaṃ garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: The sacrificial fee (dakṣiṇā) is the sacrificial cow; she bears the Yajña as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: viḍ vaśā sā kṣatriyaṃ garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: The Viś (the common people) is the sacrificial cow; she bears the Kṣatriya as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: vāg vaśā sā parameṣṭhiṇaṃ garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: Speech (Vāc) is the sacrificial cow; she bears the Supreme Being (Parameṣṭhin) as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: vaśā vaśā sā rājanyaṃ garbhaṃ (…) ||
english: The cow-sacrifice (vaśā) itself is the sacrificial cow; she bears the Rājanya as her embryo. [Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.]

sanskrit: samā vaśā sā saṃvatsaraṃ garbhaṃ dadhe semeṃ pāhi tasyai te vidheyaṃ tasyai te namas tasmai te svāhā ||
english: The Sāman is the sacrificial cow; she bears the year (Saṃvatsara) as her embryo. Protect this one; to thee is the oblation due, to thee reverence, to it svāhā.

sanskrit: sapta sūryā divam anupraviṣṭās tān pathā vā anv eti dakṣiṇāvān | te 'smai sarve ghṛtam ā tapanty ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphurantaḥ ||
english: Seven suns have entered the sky; the one endowed with the southern path follows them along their way. All of them together pour down clarified butter upon him, milking out nourishment without stumbling.

sanskrit: ātapan kṣayati nīcā dāsavyādhī niṣṭapan | adhāyatpatraḥ sūrya ud eti bṛhatīr anu ||
english: While shining down below, Sūrya destroys the disease of the Dāsas by scorching thoroughly. He who has his wings spread upward rises, following the great courses.

sanskrit: ātaptā pitṝn vidma dasyūn niṣṭaptā vayam | guhā ye 'nye sūryāḥ svadhām anu caranti te ||
english: By his upward shining we know the Pitṛs; by his thorough scorching, we know the Dasyus. Those other suns that move in secret following their own courses — they too we know.

sanskrit: dyauḥ sacate 'parāñ janāsaḥ pañcānye paro diva ā kṣiyanti | tāṃ brahma divaṃ bṛhad ā viveśa yas tān praveda prataram atīryata ||
english: Heaven goes along with these peoples; five others dwell higher still, beyond the sky. Into that vast heaven, brahman entered fully; he who truly knows them has crossed over to the farther shore.

sanskrit: yo dadāti yo dadate yo vā nidhīn śraddadhāno nidhatte | yamo vaivasvatān rājā sarvān rakṣatu śevadhīn ||
english: He who gives, he who causes gifts to be given, or he who with faith deposits treasure — may Yama, the son of Vivasvat, king, protect all those treasures.

sanskrit: mā vidan paryāyiṇo ye dakṣiṇāḥ parimuṣṇanti dattam | sugena tān pathā sarvān yamo rājāti neṣati ||
english: May the cheats who steal the sacrificial fees from the right-side donors not learn of these treasures. By an easy path King Yama leads all such transgressors away.

sanskrit: yena pathā vaivasvato yamo rājeto yayau | agnir nas tena nayatu prajānan vaiśvānaraḥ pathikṛd viśvagṛṣṭiḥ ||
english: By the path by which Vaivasvata Yama the king went hence — by that very path may Agni Vaiśvānara lead us, knowing the way, the path-maker, the herdsman of all.

sanskrit: mahi jyotir nihitaṃ martyeṣu yena devāso atarann arātīn | tenemaṃ setum ati geṣma sarve vaiśvānaraṃ jyotir amīva devāḥ ||
english: The great light is placed within mortals, by which the gods crossed over their enemies. By that bridge may we all cross over — by the Vaiśvānara light that dispels disease, O gods.

sanskrit: ud vayaṃ tamasas pari jyotiṣ paśyanta uttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryam aganma jyotir uttamam ||
english: Upward we rise, beholding the higher light beyond the darkness. We have reached the divine Sūrya among the gods, the highest light.

sanskrit: āroko bhrājaḥ paṭaraḥ pataṅgaḥ svarṇaro jyotiṣīmān vibhāsaḥ | te 'smai sarve ghṛtam ā tapanty ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphurantaḥ ||
english: Āroka, Bhrāja, Paṭara, Pataṅga, Svarṇara, the luminous Vibhāsa — all of them pour down clarified butter upon him, milking out nourishment without stumbling.
